tools.name: friendbuy_list_shares
tools.description: List referral shares sent by advocates in a date range, optionally by campaign, advocate or channel. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/shares.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_clicks
tools.description: List valid referral-link clicks in a date range, optionally by campaign or channel. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/clicks.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_account_signups
tools.description: List account sign-ups that came from a referral in a date range, filterable by campaign, customer or email. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/account-sign-ups.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_purchases
tools.description: List purchases attributed to a referral in a date range, filterable by campaign, customer or email. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/purchases.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_widget_views
tools.description: List widget views in a date range, filterable by campaign, widget name or widget type. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/widget-views.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_email_captures
tools.description: List emails captured by a widget in a date range, filterable by campaign, capture type or email. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/email-captures.

tools.name: friendbuy_get_email_metrics
tools.description: Get referral email metrics for whole days in a timezone, optionally with a daily series. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/email-metrics.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_distributed_advocate_rewards
tools.description: List advocate rewards distributed in a date range, filterable by campaign or advocate. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/distributed-advocate-rewards.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_distributed_friend_incentives
tools.description: List friend incentives distributed in a date range, filterable by campaign or friend. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/distributed-friend-incentives.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_referral_rewards
tools.description: List referral rewards in a date range, filterable by campaign or advocate. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/rewards/referral.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_loyalty_ledger_heads
tools.description: List every customer's loyalty balance head for one currency. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/loyalty/ledger-heads.

tools.name: friendbuy_get_customer
tools.description: Get a Friendbuy customer record by your customer id. Friendbuy: GET /v1/customers?id=.

tools.name: friendbuy_get_member_tier
tools.description: Get the loyalty member tier of a customer by your customer id. Friendbuy: GET /v1/customers/member-tier?id=.

tools.name: friendbuy_get_ledger_balance
tools.description: Get a customer's loyalty balance in one currency, by Friendbuy customer id (your customer id). Friendbuy: GET /v1/ledger-balance.

tools.name: friendbuy_get_custom_ledger_balance
tools.description: Get a loyalty balance by your custom customer id, for shoppers without a Friendbuy customer record. Friendbuy: GET /v1/ledger-balance-custom.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_ledger_entries
tools.description: List a customer's loyalty ledger entries in one currency, from a timestamp onward. Friendbuy: GET /v1/ledger-entries.

tools.name: friendbuy_get_user_data
tools.description: Get the personal data Friendbuy holds for one shopper, by email or your customer id (at least one). Friendbuy: GET /v1/user-data.

tools.name: friendbuy_get_referral_status
tools.description: Check a referral, product-sharing or influencer code: its campaign type and status. Case and punctuation are ignored. Friendbuy: GET /v1/referral-status.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_coupons
tools.description: List reward coupons a customer received or redeemed, by customer id or email (at least one). Friendbuy: GET /v1/reward/coupons.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_redemption_options
tools.description: List the active loyalty redemption options configured in the Friendbuy dashboard. Friendbuy: GET /v1/reward/redemption-options.

tools.name: friendbuy_track_purchase
tools.description: Record a purchase event, so a referral or reward can be attributed to it. Changes Friendbuy data. Friendbuy: POST /v1/event/purchase.

tools.name: friendbuy_track_account_signup
tools.description: Record an account sign-up event, so a referral can be credited for it. Changes Friendbuy data. Friendbuy: POST /v1/event/account-sign-up.

tools.name: friendbuy_track_custom_event
tools.description: Record a custom event of a type you define, such as a newsletter sign-up. Changes Friendbuy data. Friendbuy: POST /v1/event/custom.

tools.name: friendbuy_upsert_customer
tools.description: Add a customer to Friendbuy's records, with profile fields. Changes Friendbuy data. Friendbuy: POST /v1/customer.

tools.name: friendbuy_create_personal_referral_link
tools.description: Create, or get the existing, personal referral link for an advocate in a campaign. Friendbuy: POST /v1/personal-referral-link.

tools.name: friendbuy_send_share_email
tools.description: Send a campaign's referral share email from an advocate to up to 10 friends. Each advocate may send 10 shares a day. Sends email to third parties. Friendbuy: POST /v1/share/email.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "friendbuy_get_referral_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: friendbuy_list_account_signups, friendbuy_list_purchases, friendbuy_list_email_captures, friendbuy_get_email_metrics, friendbuy_get_user_data, friendbuy_list_coupons, friendbuy_create_personal_referral_link · Private data: friendbuy_get_customer, friendbuy_get_custom_ledger_balance, friendbuy_track_purchase, friendbuy_track_account_signup, friendbuy_track_custom_event, friendbuy_upsert_customer · Public sink: friendbuy_list_account_signups, friendbuy_list_purchases, friendbuy_list_email_captures, friendbuy_get_email_metrics, friendbuy_get_user_data, friendbuy_list_coupons, friendbuy_track_purchase, friendbuy_track_account_signup, friendbuy_track_custom_event, friendbuy_upsert_customer, friendbuy_create_personal_referral_link, friendbuy_send_share_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: friendbuy_list_account_signups, friendbuy_list_purchases, friendbuy_list_email_captures, friendbuy_get_email_metrics, friendbuy_get_user_data, friendbuy_list_coupons, friendbuy_create_personal_referral_link · Private data: friendbuy_get_customer, friendbuy_get_custom_ledger_balance, friendbuy_track_purchase, friendbuy_track_account_signup, friendbuy_track_custom_event, friendbuy_upsert_customer · Public sink: friendbuy_list_account_signups, friendbuy_list_purchases, friendbuy_list_email_captures, friendbuy_get_email_metrics, friendbuy_get_user_data, friendbuy_list_coupons, friendbuy_track_purchase, friendbuy_track_account_signup, friendbuy_track_custom_event, friendbuy_upsert_customer, friendbuy_create_personal_referral_link, friendbuy_send_share_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
